source: Static VWSC parse of SnowCraft.exe movie (never executed). Director blend 255 = transparent, 0 = opaque. Phaser alpha = 1 - blend/255.
decoder: ScummVM engines/director/images.cpp BITDDecoder D4+ 32-bit: PackBits, each row is A,R,G,B planes of width bytes. SnowCraft 32-bit text BITDs have unused (0) alpha; white is the matte.

levelWord.note: Level 6 uses ink 39 (darkest) on the word channel; digit is still ink 8.

levelDigits.parserCheck: CASt spec+18/+20 minus initialRect matches ScummVM D8 BitmapCastMember (directorVersion 1600, kFileVer800). Validated against ground (300,160), 8-bit digits 2–4, logo/Congratulations centre regs, and Play Again negative reg (−216,−138) which pins the button at stage bottom-right. DCR inflated FGEI contains the exact 28-byte digit-5 and digit-6 spec blobs (reg 54 and 30).
levelDigits.filmstrip: 32-bit CASt regs 54,30,7,−17,−41 step by −24/−23/−24/−24. Same VWSC loc 326 as digits 2–4. Placement uses the 8-bit slot left edge 356 (loc 326, reg_x −30), not the stale filmstrip CASt. Vertical CASt reg_y is kept.
levelDigits.levels8and9: Level word is still present: ch15 (not ch3) at loc (286,160). Digit remains ch2.

playfield.note: Present on Event Loop ch2 but blend 255 (hidden during play).

playAgain.name: snowcraft_palatte
playAgain.note: CASt name is a palette typo. BITD is the original Play Again button (blue). Negative registration is the same Director pattern as digits 2–4: loc stays near stage centre, bitmap sits at bottom-right.

unusedGroundVariant.name: snowcraft_256
unusedGroundVariant.note: 8-bit 600×320 snow field. No VWSC sprite. Not a UI banner.

notPresent: No GAME OVER BITD. Loss screen is the Happy Holidays logo plus Lingo Play Again / SCORE.
No YOU WIN BITD. Victory banner is member 88 Congratulations! then the logo.
